title: Unique descent of an invariant affine basic-open morphism
statement: Let H be a commutative ring, C a domain H-algebra, h in H with h_C=algebraMap H C h nonzero, G a group, rho:G -> End_H(C) any family of H-algebra endomorphisms (no action laws required), and K a subgroup. Let F be the intersection over zeta in K of the equalizer subalgebras of rho(zeta) and id, let h_F=algebraMap H F h, U=D(h_F) in Spec F, V=D(h_C) in Spec C, and q:V -> U the restriction of Spec(F -> C). The restricted deck maps are fixedPunctureDeck of [lem-sbc-affine-torsor-split-label-laws]. For any affine scheme Z and a:V -> Z such that deck(zeta) followed by a equals a for every zeta in K, there is a unique s:U -> Z such that q followed by s equals a. Neither G nor K is required to be finite.

source.place: Tag 03SF, affine stabilizer quotient application; the explicit domain-localization calculation and its generalization are written by N3 and completely checked in Lean.

proof.text: Put LC=Localization.Away h_C and LF=Localization.Away h_F. The inclusion induces e:LF -> LC by Localization.awayMap. Localization.awayMap_injective_iff and injectivity of the subalgebra inclusion show e is injective. IsLocalization.injective and powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors give injectivity of C -> LC.

For each zeta define v(zeta):LC -> LC using IsLocalization.Away.lift of rho(zeta) followed by C -> LC. The denominator is a unit and is fixed because rho(zeta) is an H-algebra map. IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq gives v(zeta)(algebraMap c)=algebraMap(rho(zeta)c).

For an invariant y in LC, IsLocalization.Away.surj writes y*algebraMap(h_C)^n=algebraMap(c). Apply v(zeta) to this equation; the fixed denominator and invariance of y give algebraMap(rho(zeta)c)=algebraMap(c). Injectivity gives rho(zeta)c=c for each zeta, so Algebra.mem_iInf and AlgHom.mem_equalizer give c in F.

The element algebraMap(c in F)*invSelf(h_F)^n of LF maps to y: multiply both sides by algebraMap(h_C)^n, use IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, the localization map equation and the fraction equation, then cancel the unit denominator. Thus every invariant y has a preimage under e.

Identify U and V with Spec LF and Spec LC using basicOpenIsoSpecAway. The restricted q and deck maps correspond to Spec e and Spec v respectively. Check these identities by composing with the open-immersion Spec localization maps, using basicOpenIsoSpecAway_hom_SpecMap, Hom.resLE_comp_ι and Spec.map_comp; injectivity of the localization morphisms as monomorphisms gives cancellation.

Conjugate a by these isomorphisms and Z.isoSpec. Spec.preimage gives phi:Gamma(Z) -> LC. Invariance and Spec.map_injective show v(zeta)(phi(r))=phi(r). Choose preimages of each phi(r) under e, which are unique because e is injective. Applying e verifies all four ring-homomorphism laws, so these preimages form phiF:Gamma(Z) -> LF.

Take s=U -> Spec LF -> Spec Gamma(Z) -> Z from phiF. The localization naturality identity and e composed with phiF=phi give q composed with s=a. For any competing s, Spec.preimage yields a ring map phiPrime with e composed with phiPrime=phi. Injectivity of e gives phiPrime=phiF, and full faithfulness of Spec plus cancellation of the affine isomorphisms gives equality with s.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_invariant_basic_open_descent
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra H C] [IsDomain C]
    (h : H) (hne : algebraMap H C h ≠ 0)
    (G : Type u) [Group G] (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C) (K : Subgroup G)
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Z]
    (a : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C h)) ⟶ Z)
    (ha : ∀ ζ : K, fixedPunctureDeck H C h G ρ ζ.val ≫ a = a) :
    let F := (⨅ ζ : K, AlgHom.equalizer (ρ ζ.val) (AlgHom.id H C) : Subalgebra H C)
    let U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of F)).Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H F h)
    let q := (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom F.val.toRingHom)).resLE
      U (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C h)) (by
        change PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C h) ≤
          PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C h)
        rfl)
    ∃! s : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of F)) U ⟶ Z, q ≫ s = a
